title: When the Inheritance Burns Anew
author: Lena Dunmore
blurb: Yara Yarrow, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
